title: Read-Only Live GitHub Actions Execution and Hosted Artifact Acquisition
api_lookup_limitation: Connected workflow-run lookup is pull-request filtered and cannot exhaust push or workflow_dispatch runs; no actual completed CI run was confirmed.
intended_observations: Require exact 40-digit SHA and explicit Actions run ID from an already completed run
Use GITHUB_TOKEN read-only authenticated REST calls to actual run, jobs and artifacts endpoints
Fetch actual qualification-job log bytes and GitHub-hosted Actions artifact ZIP bytes by their API IDs
Hash observed API payloads, real job-log bytes and hosted artifact bytes using SHA-256
Reject incomplete pages, missing byte streams, mismatched commit/run or failed steps
Treat running own-workflow metadata as NONTERMINAL, never a completed CI PASS
Do not confuse GitHub API observation with independent runner attestation, original hardware or external custody
No external physical ACT, history selection, lock reclamation, recovery or repair
known_qualifications: The in-workflow probe executes before artifact upload; it cannot verify its own final artifact and must fail closed
No independently completed GitHub Actions run ID was observed for this bound
No independently retrieved hosted Actions artifact bytes were obtained
Caller-supplied or GitHub-owned evidence does not establish separate third-party custody
